why: LookAtMyQuant supplies an mlx-lm model adapter for it, but its cache lacks the nbytes that mlx-lm 0.32.2's server reads when it keeps a prompt cache. mlx-lm 0.32.2 also has no parser for Inkling's tool calls; its Inkling 2 support is a draft pull request. We did not establish a working tool-call route in this setup. By the maintainer's decision, it waits for mlx-lm's Inkling support or a LookAtMyQuant server.
